ModMetaData.name: Underlayer
ModMetaData.author: Unon
ModMetaData.description:
A framework for mods that draw Dear ImGui windows on RimWorld 1.7.
Normally every ImGui window sits on top of every vanilla window, so a mod's ImGui window can hide a dialog that opened after it. Underlayer fixes that: ImGui windows from mods that use it are stacked together with vanilla windows, in the same order as the game's own window stack.
Does nothing on its own. Mods that use it will list it as a dependency. RimWorld 1.7 only.
